independent_reference.source: Analytic closed-form per-particle force -grad E(p_i), E(x)=R(x)-G(U(x)), hand-derived chain rule through K(r)=w_k exp(-(r-mu_k)^2/sigma_k^2), G(u)=exp(-(u-mu_g)^2/sigma_g^2), R(x)=(c_rep/2) sum max(1-r,0)^2 (sum over j!=i). The Taichi engine implements the same analytic gradient; this NumPy mirror is the independent bit-faithful cross-implementation (the smoke-diff mirror pattern). Source: Mordvintsev/Niklasson/Randazzo 2022, Google Research Self-Organising Systems, 'Particle Lenia and the energy-based formulation' (https://google-research.github.io/self-organising-systems/particle-lenia/). Canonical LOCAL rule.

Central finite-difference baseline -grad E(p_i) ~ -(E(x+eps)-E(x-eps))/(2eps), eps=1e-6, O(eps^2). Independent numerical method (parameter perturbation of the energy field) cross-checking the engine force. close-R2 numerical-baseline exemption.

Translation invariance of the TOTAL energy: E_total(P+delta) == E_total(P) exactly (E depends only on pairwise distances; equivalently sum_i grad_{p_i} E_total = 0, a Noether-like momentum identity). NOTE the LOCAL force sum is NOT zero (the local rule does not conserve momentum); the sound symmetry anchor is the global-energy invariance. Hand-derived.
